resources.string: Detox uses this to notice WHICH app you open, nothing more. When a paused app opens during a quiet time, after your daily limit or while strict mode is on, Detox closes it. It cannot read your screen, messages or passwords. Detox has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
Closes paused apps at the times you choose
Detox is a calm bouncer for your phone. It only notices which app opens, so it can close social media during your quiet times.

Optional. Closes Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and keeps the rest of both apps (messages, stories, normal videos). To spot them, the guard checks the names of screen parts, like \"the Reels tab is selected\", inside Instagram and YouTube only. It does not read texts, messages or passwords, and Android gives it no events from other apps. Detox has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
Closes Reels and Shorts, keeps the rest
Keep Instagram and YouTube for messages and normal videos, but skip the endless short videos.
